source: NHTSA crash-test and compliance-test reports (nrd-static.nhtsa.dot.gov, static.nhtsa.gov/odi/ctr): the vehicle data sheet (final drive, engine displacement, cylinders, transmission type and speeds, seating capacity, certification-label GVWR, measured weight as delivered) and the test title; compared with vPIC DecodeVINValuesBatch of each test vehicle's own VIN (decode audit 2026-11-17).
rules: Pattern = VIN positions 1-8, 10 (model year) and 11 (plant). Values as the lab recorded them; a value the audit found to be a lab misprint or a parser misread is withheld with the reason; a value whose dispute the audit could not settle is kept and marked disputed (the site never corrects on a disputed value alone).
